name: Upload a Build Artifact
description: Upload a build artifact that can be used by subsequent workflow steps

path.description: A file, directory or wildcard pattern that describes what to upload

if-no-files-found.description:
The desired behavior if no files are found using the provided path.
Available Options:
  warn: Output a warning but do not fail the action
  error: Fail the act

retention-days.description:
Duration after which artifact will expire in days. 0 means using default retention.
Minimum 1 day. Maximum 90 days unless changed from the repository settings p
